g.title: Connectivity / Wi-Fi: partial / not fully integrated - stable MAC/IP since 2026-09-29; 11 s reconnect after wake
Connectivity / Cellular modem: missing - out of scope
Connectivity / Bluetooth: ready
Connectivity / Bluetooth headset mic (HFP): missing
Connectivity / Tailscale: ready - one daemon per host; ramdisk tailscaled only as a fallback
Connectivity / Hotspot: needs a test
Connectivity / GPS: missing
Connectivity / NFC: missing
Sensors & hardware / Cameras: missing
Sensors & hardware / Touchscreen: ready
Sensors & hardware / Motion sensors (SLPI): ready
Sensors & hardware / Buttons: ready
Sensors & hardware / Vibration: ready
Sensors & hardware / Light / proximity: ready - proximity near level from the factory calibration
Sensors & hardware / Fingerprint: missing
Sensors & hardware / AirTriggers: missing
Sensors & hardware / RGB logo LED: partial / not fully integrated
Boot & updates / Signed boot chain: ready - slot-B wrapper, try-once selector, signed fallback safe-r7
Boot & updates / Kernel updates: ready - file writes on p24, automatic fallback

Boot & updates / Unattended package updates: needs a test - reboots only when idle (no remote client, no sound, 01-06 window); snapshots exclude user data (~6 GB); v2 restore passed fault injection, not yet a real rollback
Boot & updates / Boot splash: needs a test - r187 keeps the bootloader logo until phoc (0107/0108); needs a visual check
Boot & updates / Boot time: partial / not fully integrated - ~56 s to multi-user on r201 (23 s kernel + initramfs, 33 s userspace); Wi-Fi at ~57 s
Boot & updates / Reboot to fastboot: missing - reboot argument ignored by the shutdown script
Display & shell / AMOLED panel: ready - 1080x2448 at 60 Hz
Display & shell / Phosh: needs a test - hotplug crash fixes installed (phosh 0.57.0-1.3, phoc 0.57.0-1.2), no crash since 2026-09-30 00:00; plug/unplug stress test pending
Display & shell / Brightness: partial / not fully integrated - about 4 real steps
Display & shell / High refresh rate: missing - 60 Hz only
Display & shell / Lock screen & PIN: ready
Display & shell / App launch feedback: ready - Chromium desktop file fixed; Firefox splash still times out
Power / Deep standby (CX/DDR collapse): missing - DDR stays at 200 MHz in suspend (~79 mA), cause still traced; bisect kit ready (noslpi/noadsp/cdsp DTBs)
Power / Charging & limits: ready - charge limit and bypass
Power / Suspend (s2idle): ready
Power / Battery standby measurement: needs a test - needs the phone unplugged
Power / Idle background wakeups: partial / not fully integrated - desktop-mode switcher event-driven (~0.1 % CPU), tailscaled retry loop gone; sleep policy still polls every 5 s
Power / Memory (zram swap): ready - 5.2 GiB zram zstd, MGLRU, THP madvise
Performance / CPU: ready - GB6 1580/4191 (above Android)
Performance / GPU (Vulkan/GL): ready - GB6 Vulkan 4670 normal, 5405 performance mode
Performance / Thermal protection: ready - skin + junction trips, 65 C shutdown
Performance / Performance mode: partial / not fully integrated - rog5-perf-mode auto: performance limits on external power with a DP display; no toggle in Phosh yet
Performance / System monitor (Resources): ready

External display / DP alt mode (2 lanes, HBR2): ready - native DP monitors at HBR2 (0110), MSI 491C 3840x1080@60 with keyboard/mouse behind its hub; first-enable blue screen fixed at the root (0130-0132)
External display / GNOME desktop mode: partial / not fully integrated - event-driven, fail-closed switcher; mode manual until one supervised boot test; switching closes apps
External display / 4-lane DP, 5120x1440, 100 Hz: missing - in progress (0136-0139, not in r104); 0114 rejects 5120x1440@60 and 3840x1080@100 until relaxed
External display / No DPU clock pin: ready - GNOME without the 460 MHz pin: 5/5 clean first enables on r104 (ca10325b)
External display / Touchscreen as touchpad: ready
External display / HDMI converters above HBR: missing - the hub HDMI PCON stays dark at HBR2; converters capped at HBR (1080p60); 0119/0134 opt-in experiments
External display / HDR: missing - later: port of stock VSC/HDR-metadata SDPs
USB / Side port host + hubs: ready - survives suspend (0105); monitor hub USB comes up at boot via reconnect retries
USB / Replug recovery (-71): partial / not fully integrated - rog5-usb-reconnect re-initialises the controller; kernel fix (0142 retries / 0143 session override) needs the one-replug test
USB / Charging via hub: ready

USB / Bottom port (USB 2.0 host): partial / not fully integrated - 5 V switched by hand (rog5-usb-bottom on); stage B (RT1715 + TCPM, automatic 5 V) built as DT feature usbbtmtc, not composed; needs a power-meter test
USB / USB gadget (network to a PC): ready
USB / USB drives (Files/Disks): ready - udisks with a polkit guard for the internal UFS; ISO9660/UDF/exFAT/NTFS3
USB / USB 3 on the side port: missing - SuperSpeed not verified; the monitor hub runs at USB 2.0 (480M) next to DP
Audio / Speakers: ready - full strength via PipeWire S16LE (e29c5ad3)
Audio / Speaker protection DSP: needs a test - running on both amps with factory calibration (0121-0124); robustness tests pending
Audio / 24-bit playback: partial / not fully integrated - the S24_LE front end (q6asm PCM_V2) reaches the amps far below full scale; PipeWire forced to S16LE
Audio / Microphones: ready
Audio / Earpiece: missing
Audio / 3.5 mm jack: missing
Audio / Bluetooth audio: needs a test
Audio / Audio over DP: missing
Server / SSH (keys only): ready
Server / 128 GiB persistent root: ready - overlay loop with direct I/O (4 KiB blocks)
Server / Firewall (nftables): ready
Server / Hardware watchdog: ready
Server / Journal retention: ready - 1 GB cap; excluded from update snapshots
Apps / Steam (native arm64): partial / not fully integrated - Valve's aarch64 client; x86 games through FEX (Half-Life ran); title-bar drag does nothing in GNOME
Apps / Browsers: ready - Firefox and Chromium
